dataset.name: global-fortune-competition-2010-2025
dataset.gold_policy: Use the locally cached official answer key as the contest scoring target; do not relabel from model preference.
dataset.split_unit: whole contest year and whole case

frozen_runner.known_limit: Codex subagents share the workspace filesystem, so this is procedural allowlist isolation rather than an OS-level read barrier; public-page pretraining memory also cannot be excluded.

development.use: Reveal, diagnose and iterate. Repeated scores are training-fit or regression scores only.

regression.use: Lock old and candidate Skill predictions before reveal, then make one paired comparison. After reveal this split becomes exposed regression data.

holdout.use: Reveal once after the final candidate is frozen. After reveal, require new external questions for another generalization claim.
holdout.current_status: revealed once on 2026-08-10; exhausted as a holdout

cycle: Freeze model, reasoning effort, solver prompt, Skill hash and split manifest.
With the current Skill, lock predictions for every still-sealed year before revealing any new answer.
Reveal development years only after the full development batch is locked.
Assign exactly one primary root cause per error using the fixed decision order.
Patch only deterministic calculation defects or recurrent causes supported by at least three questions across at least two independent cases.
Run calculation unit tests and exposed-development regression checks.
Lock the candidate Skill on the still-sealed regression split, then reveal old and candidate rounds together and compute paired delta.
Freeze the final candidate before touching holdout answers; reveal holdout once.
Move every revealed item to exposed training/regression status and never call its later score blind accuracy.

change_gate.deterministic_bug: One reproducible calculation defect is sufficient, but the fix must add a unit test.
change_gate.rule_or_reasoning_change: Require at least three errors across at least two independent cases with the same recurrence key.
forbidden: one-off rules that merely restate a revealed option
change_gate.rollback: Do not promote a change that improves exposed development but worsens the paired sealed split without a pre-registered safety justification.

metrics.primary: exact-match micro accuracy on the sealed split
required: top-label Brier score when confidence is recorded
metrics.claim_gate: Say accuracy improved only when the paired holdout delta is positive and its case-level bootstrap interval excludes zero; otherwise report a trend or no demonstrated improvement.
